The token set has no member for this product. Defaulting to storefront is forbidden by the rule, and admin-spa denotes the Platform Admin SPA (virto-doc-style §9.1 shape is 'Click {Module} in the main menu -> {blade}' with a playwright-edge screenshot), so mapping vc-shell there would mis-route the audience. TOOLING GAP, not a run failure.

Tracker precedent for this class is inconsistent (VCST-5812 and VCST-5813 are Low), so the grade was put to the operator rather than decided silently; operator chose Medium.
measurement_notes: Instrument validated before use: browser_find '[active]' reported textbox 'Password' pre-sign-in.

The Tab-once discriminator is NON-DISCRIMINATING for the VCST-5859 path: nav precedes main in DOM order, so a genuine continuation and a restart both land on the blade's first control. Evidence is the absent [active] node.

Condition 6 (Save) passes because the blade REMOUNTS (region ref e10641 -> e10809 -> e11144), so onMounted(focusIfLoose) catches the loose focus. The save path hands nothing off and is untouched by these fixes - it would regress silently if the blade stopped remounting.

Self-disabling-button condition measured on pagination, not the framework Sign in button: the sign-in redirect completes before a probe can run. A wrong-password attempt was declined to avoid risking the admin account.
